review_text: We love Q minder!. I am a Director of a Testing Center at a Community College and have been using Q minder for a few years. Q minder has helped us tremendously with controlling the flow of students coming in, especially during busy times. In the past students would fill our reception area anxiously waiting to be served which in turn would make our staff anxious as well! Now students are free to walk around and relax outside the testing area until they are notified. Q minder’s Data insights allows us to review and analyze traffic patterns to help us staff our center efficiently and effectively.

Great tool for customer service. We use qminder everyday and it has helped us calling guests and keeping a detailed record of who is coming in and what we are helping them with. Very useful tool for any customer service based business!

Best Queue Management Tool. Overall we were able to process a LOT more visitors, reduce wait times and capture a lot more information about visitors. It was a core contributor of an increase of efficiency, overall capacity and customer happiness.
Amazing. Qminder is the best app. It makes work so much easier and gives you all the data insights you need.

No longer can use without log in. I used to use this app to sign in to my medical lab for bloodwork. It was helpful because it showed how many people were waiting. Now I can no longer use it. To get a log in you have to pay now after a 14 day free trail. Not happy
App won’t load. App won’t load on my iphone all of a sudden. Works on my iPad. Seems this app doesn’t get updated much either.

Lost features. I use this app for work and I love the fact that I can use it on my phone. However, with this new layout, I can no longer view the list of people who are waiting unless I am on a computer.
Irene. Could not sign in.
What a great queuing system. We used Qminder for a year and it has been an excellent addition to our service model. The iPad interface and recent updates to the app make it super easy to manage.
So easy to use and set-up!. This app is the perfect complement to the Queuing system. You can manage your lines, staff and consult your dashboard live. It lets you manage your flow from everywhere!
column7: Very Useful and Simple. I work at a retail store and this became very handy. I know this is meant for restaurants but, I can see the potential of the app working for different businesses. In my store we always had a problem with space. We would get 15-30 customers either standing or sitting (if they get a chance) waiting to get there turn. This app has given me the ability to control traffic in my department and also gave the ability for customers to shop around while they wait.A good tip for an improvement: I am using an iPad Mini with an AppleTV hooked up. It would be great to have a display of the waiting list in full screen so customers can know who is ahead of them. Also while having that ability, when it comes to adding customers to the list it would be great to not show any personal information on the AppleTV until the customer is added.Plus I would love to put our own logo on the background. Just to make my display neater.Thank you for this app.

review_text: Perfect for our restaurant. Our restaurant is a midsize bar and grill and this app is perfect for our waitlist needs. We only 18 tables in the restaurant we tend to get on a wait very quickly. Nextme is perfect for notifying people over text so they don't have to wait inside the small restaurant. They have great customer service that fixes problems as soon as they arise. It's easy to learn and there have been no problems training hosts on how to work it. The app has created a smoother pace for our restaurant and helped us get customers seated quicker than ever before. Highly recommended and I can't say enough good things about it.

Great App for my restaurant!. Nextme has been a lifesaver during our busiest weekend times!  we have a clear list of all names, place to list client's location in the restaurant so we can locate them when it's their turn, and most importantly, a time marker for when the client checked in with the amount of time they have waited.  all these functions and more have been so helpful in keeping our clients happy while they wait in line.  super shoutout to the nextme team for providing this app and services!!

Wow...game changer.. My gf and I went to this lil restaurant called Oiistar by my place last wknd, and the host said there'd be a 20min wait. We were starving, but he took down our number and said we could have a drink at the arcade bar across the street. We got a text right away showing our place in line. Sure enough, after I finished my beer I got a text saying that we were next! So easy and convenient...I've never been to Oiistar before (must've walked past it 100x), but we'll def be back.

Best Waitlist App!. Highly recommend this app! I was on the search for an easy and simple waitlist app for my restaurant and this was the best one! At first I was a bit iffy switching to technology and getting rid of paper and pen... but it was the best move ever! If you're thinking of using a waitlist app look no further plus customer service is awesome.

Happy Customers, Happy Restaurant. The App NextMe has been a very effective tool for our restaurant. Our hostesses are able to manage our wait list much more efficiently and our table turns have definitely improved! John and James are awesome and have been very responsive. We are delighted to support a local up and coming business!

Best by far. Nextme is the best wait list app I have tried in the App Store. Setup is super simple and customers love getting a coffee or wandering the neighborhood while waiting. No complaints here at all and it is dirt cheap on top of all that. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for an easy way to manage waitlists.

This app simply makes us better. We opened our doors w long waits and hostesses screaming names. This really works well, and makes us much more professional. 5 minutes to learn. Also you can view the waits from any I phone. We love the app and the customer service is awesome.

Almost Perfect. Let’s be honest the app is pretty much perfect but I really wish you could take away displaying peoples phone numbers. Maybe give us some more settings within the app that enable personalizing. Also when I make a custom queue and select it within the app, instant crash. Over though great app

Simple and the best waitlist app out there!!. This is by far the easiest wait list app I found in the app store. Our hosts love how simple it is to get started. The text message marketing also helps us turn tables as we can display our menus to waiting patrons. Overall, great app!

better than before but still not great. The app is faster than the previous solution of saving a bookmark to your homepage and it’s nice that the different queues are on the same page so I don’t have to switch back and forth. But the chat feature needs a lot of work because for some reason, the chat tab is only showing anonymized chats from months ago, I can’t see any recent incoming chats. And half the time if somebody who’s been there before sends a message, it sends the message to the older anonymized chat log which makes it impossible to find what they said without getting a computer. Also it would be nice to see a feature where we can select which fields you can see in the preview of the customer’s information, that way I wouldn’t have to open it up every time. Big props for adding a customer registration tab into the app though makes it a lot easier to sign people up when they don’t know what they’re doing 🙏

Automatic, Supersonic, Funky Fresh!. Waitwhile has changed the game and continues to provide the best support and services. They’re quick to respond, easy to use, and always releasing the best new features! The app makes it so easy to manage my account and keep track of everything going on, right from my phone! I’d recommend this to anyone looking for a waitlist and booking system.
It runs itself. Have used it for last five years.  Customers love how easy it is. It’s best thing that’s happened to my business.
Amazing app. Waitwhile has revolutionized our haunted house operations. The app is very smooth and user friendly.
Great interface. Super easy to use for our staff and great visibility for our managers!

App doesn’t work till 9:00.. The app is really good, but it’s a shame it doesn’t work till 9:00 am when the license office opens. I understand for those waiting in line outside, but that should be posted somewhere on the sign to use the app. It was frustrating trying to use the app before 9 AM.

Kind of: not positive about your existence. If you can claim possibility that you are there. I lost line. I panicked because there was no appointments on the same day I came. So the next day I gotten in. But took over 11 from my appointment. I used something like this before from my previous school for financial aid. And I assume it kept me updated about my turn. I don’t remember if it was this app. This app told 114min or so afar. The one I mentioned before really knew you were coming in. Line respected. Not sure if it updates well. I was 5 people near my appointment. By redoing it. I was at 2nd. When I lost my line inside the building. Somehow!!! >:0 even seeing the pre enter people, did not guarantee my line! well I was first when I re-enter after my line lost. Other than that it left me in confusion of why I couldn’t go the previous day. Of course I was watching my turn. Waiting for previous line waiter to end their turn. Please don’t hang up on my while I’m waiting inside!!!

Good service, not a great app. The service QLess provides is great, but the app itself has some bugs. Biggest for me right now is that I moved to a new phone and when I try to add my number it says it’s already in use on a different device (my old phone) with no way to remove it. I removed the app to see if it would help and it recognized me but I can’t remove it and set it up on my device.Also searching is terrible and shows nothing similar to my searches. I know my local DMVs use QLess but I can’t find them in the app at all and have to use their website.Finally, when I search and click the X to clear the field or cancel the search, my previous search terms remain in the search box and can create confusion. The only way to clear the field is to tap the “near me” option. It’s a small detail, but it’s an indication of a lack of Polish to the app. Not a big deal, but worth mentioning. The phone number issue and the searching issues are pretty big deals to me though.

Improvements required. App needs to support the full screen on iPads. Also would really like it if you added support for push notifications so that the app does not have to be open all the time for us to be able know what the current wait time is for any line we are in. Also how about add a account manger so that I can view the same info on my iPad as on my iPhone this way both are in sync. Also when a school uses your system for the prep use of study rooms have it ask number of people and ask for names and phone numbers of the additional people so that the correct study room can be made available as well as provide better wait time for availability. Also add integration into a school library check in/check out computer system this way as room keys are checked in and out it would update wait times with better accuracy.

Less can be confusing. I arrived just as my text alerted me that it was time. I still waited 45”. However, every single staff member at the Concord Plaza location treated each and every patron with a smile, a hello, performed professionally and efficiently. I visited the Maplewood Deer Park location earlier in the afternoon And after being told by the male employee that I was next, 6 other patrons were called ahead of me. I questioned the female employee who summarily dismissed me. I wanted an explanation as the QLess system is very confusing regarding trying to pick the service you need - nothing for transferring plates. The Maplewood Deer. Creek employees treated each patron with disdain and as an inconvenience. It was disheartening and gives these offices the bad reputation that they are known for. Do better Belle Hart Schmidt, LLC.

Freakin' Awesome. This app has turned Secretary of State from an absolute nightmare to an actual pleasant experience. I'm a 38 yr old woman who dreads SOS. Now, I checked in online it told me I had approx 70 mins, went grocery shopping, was running a little late and was able to just request adding on 10 mins to my wait time. I was allowed to push back my time 3x! It was like SOS was actually trying to make my life a little easier and stress free... And it worked. I've never written a review before but if this is the "new SOS experience" I think I should scream it from the roof top. Awesome. Can't wait to explore this app further and see what other lines I won't have to wait in 😬😀 I mean..

Makes iOS users very sad. You know it’s bad when I have to write a review for the first time. The app is pretty alright when my dad uses it because he has a Samsung phone; however, I have a big fat iPhone and this app has been a disaster at every corner. When I enter the app and pick a location (provided it doesn’t freeze and kick me out in the first minute) the app asks for your phone number and then doesn’t send a confirmation text. Cool, that’s fine I guess — except there’s nowhere in the app for me to check what lines I’m already queued up for. There’s no way to know if you’re actually in line, or if you gave them the wrong number, or if the app glitched and froze after hitting enter (which indeed happened the first time I used the app, so I had to enter the same line twice). Would not recommend unless they fix hella stuff.

Secretary of State. We all know how dreadful going to the Secretary of State in Michigan can be.. and most likely, in all states for that matter... after losing my wallet, this trip was my biggest obstacle... normally a 30-60 minute wait with America's finest. Thanks to this app, I just skipped a 40 minute line that was wrapped out of the front door and into the 80 degree heat... QLess held my spot in line and I walked in as I was being called, outta there in 5 minutes with a new license being mailed to me for $9. Saving time is saving money, so do yourself the favor and download this app and support its growth. Shoutout to the developer - you've made your mark on Earth!! You should be extremely proud.

No way to cancel appointment in app. This is such a good idea but some important things are missing. This works perfectly if you never need to reschedule or cancel. I need multiple appts with city planning dept, and I need to be able to go into the app to cancel a meeting if there has been a delay in getting the documents needed for that meeting. I even tried texting “C” to cancel all my meetings so I could start over, but that did nothing. Basically, this app (and the fact that the Planning Dept. does not answer telephone calls) forces users who need to cancel to be the jerk that just doesn’t show up. It would be so simple to add the option “cancel appointment.” That would make this perfect.

Post Falls ID. Don’t use this app to make an appointment in post falls because it thinks the DMV is where drivers licensing is done and it is actually done in the sheriffs office. My wife and I sat there for 3 hours. It said we were 6th in line so we booked it over there then it said we were 1st in line but our names were never called then it said we were 4th in line and we waited a while they never called our name. We ask some what the heck is going on and they told us we made an appointment at the DMV. So we walked over there it was right next door and all of a sudden I got a text saying I was 6th in line. I’m thinking it looks at your GPS to see if you are there or not. Not completely sure but we then went back to the sheriffs office and saw our names on the board. Very frustrating

Useless so far. I keep trying to book an appointment with a business for a day next week. The app won't let me--just keeps telling me that they're closed right now. Well, yes, I know that--if they were open, I would just go down there instead of wasting my time with this useless app. I've clicked every link, explored every screen, but I've accomplished nothing. I did give it two stars instead of one because it's possible that the problem isn't entirely with the app, it's with the business I'm trying to schedule with. Maybe they haven't set it up right on their end? It's hard to tell. The developer's website is aimed at selling the service and supporting businesses who buy it--no instructions or troubleshooting at all for individual users. I don't know what I'm supposed to be seeing or doing in the app, or whose fault it is that I can't--I only know it's doing nothing it was advertised to do.

Not worth the download, doesn't do what it says.. For the record, this app doesn't let you skip anything. It set an APPOINTMENT for me, with a specific TIME. After traveling to the location I arrived and approximately 4 minutes before my APPOINTMENT, it had the audacity to pop up and tell me that it would be at least 20 more minutes before my turn. If I wanted to sit and wait 20 minutes in line, I can do that without this stupid app. That isn't skipping anything. Plus even then it won't show how many people are ahead of you in the queue. Furthermore, if I knew my time could be moved, I would have picked the time 20 minutes earlier, rather than being honest about my arrival time only to drive there and still have to wait. Just call it "remotelino" or something and don't show times like it's an appointment when it's not. 1 star. Didn't save me crap die time and I left without getting my business done because I specifically didn't have the 20 minutes to wait that it lied to me about.

Wasting even more time. What's even worse, we could before go to the place and do our errands privately, but in Skiplino we'll have to provide very personal data to the app that has absolutely nothing to do with thing we want/need. Absolutely appalling!
